parts.name: Knurled adjustment knob

fit_guidance_mm.thread: M8-like external threaded stem uses 8 mm nominal diameter and 1.25 mm pitch; verify final thread profile with the target nut before production.

main_features: main cylindrical knob body on Z
diamond knurl band cut by crossed diagonal grooves
smooth shoulder or stem under knob
thread modeled as helical bead using repeated hull spheres
design_rules: diamond knurl uses two crossed groove directions around the knob circumference
external thread has core cylinder plus helical ridge segments
stem diameter should be smaller than knob diameter and larger than thread diameter
thread pitch should match intended metric fastener, for M8 coarse use 1.25 mm
validation_criteria: knob, stem, and threaded shaft stacked along Z
failure_modes: smooth cylinder without diamond knurl grooves
thread pitch omitted or unrelated to thread height
stem diameter larger than knob diameter

constraint_checks.expression: for-loop for crossed diamond knurl grooves
constraint_checks.message: Knob should have repeated crossed knurl grooves for ergonomic gripping.
